Maya - AE: EncorePay wants a short technical preflight: SSO (SAML), SCIM delta + bulk, RBAC examples, and domain proofing options. legal wants responses by tomorrow. who can drive tech answers?

Omar - Solutions: Ill take this. key items: delegated domain claims (they prefer automated DNS TXT), SCIM bulk throughput and safe retry/backoff, and a simple RBAC->scope mapping for their app roles.

Priya - Security: on questionnaire: confirm we support signed/encrypted assertions, idp-initiated SSO, and metadata signing. SCIM over TLS1.2+ required; mTLS available for Private customers. audit logs retained 90 days for Dedicated by default.

Maya - AE: they also asked about SAML key rollover best practice and if we support assertion encryption.

Omar - Solutions: yes for assertion encryption. recommend 7-day overlap for metadata/key rollover + start testing new keys 3 days before cutover. include this snippet in the reply:
```
rotation_window_days: 7
lookahead_days: 3
```

Omar - Solutions: SCIM POC defaults to suggest: delta_rate_limit_per_min=200, bulk_window_s=1200, retry_backoff=exponential(2s,max=5m). will paste exact config.

Maya - AE: pricing? they want a 7-day Dedicated trial (3x A100 equiv) + hosted fallback.

Jon - Finance: 7d, 3 GPUs list=$10,500. suggested trial discount 30% -> $7,350. egress billed separately. pro-rate handled daily. contact finance@redwood.com for custom terms.

provision-bot: estimate ENC-330999 created: 7d dedicated (3x A100) list=$10500 discounted=$7350. ticket ENC-330999 opened.

Priya - Security: i'll fill the security questionnaire QIDs and attach SOC2 reference. Omar, send me the QID map and the RBAC JSON snippet.

Omar - Solutions: will post the technical appendix and RBAC sample in the ticket in ~1h.

Maya - AE: thanks all. action items: Omar -> tech appendix + config, Priya -> security questionnaire, Jon -> confirm billing line items. Ill reply to EncorePay after we have draft. :thumbsup:
